section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2001
title: CHAPTER – 2 SUICIDES IN INDIA Incidence And Rate Of Suicides in the Decade (1991–2001) More then one lakh (1,08,506) persons lost their lives by committing suicide in the country during the year 2001. This number was, however, marginally lower than the pervious year (1,08,593) by 0.1 per cent. During the decade (1991–2001) the incidents of suicides have increased at a compound growth rate of 3.75 per cent as against the corresponding rate of population of only 1.9 per cent [Table — 2 .1] The suicides during the decade (1991 – 2001) recorded an increase of 38.3 per cent (from 78,450 suicides in 1991 to 1,08,506 suicides in 2001). Infact, the increase in incidents of Suicide was reported each year during the decade except in 1995,1996, 2000 and 2001. During the decade, the population grew by 21.4 per cent and the rate of suicide increased by 14 per cent. The rate of suicide during 2001 was 10.6 as against 10.8 in 2000 and 9.3 in 1991.
